killers.name: test_several_loads_at_once_are_just_a_bigger_load
killers.title: Three appliances together move the offer by the sum of them, not by the largest.

killers.name: test_a_dull_day_charges_almost_nothing_rather_than_buying_it
killers.title: On a day with too little sun for the smallest charge, the car is left alone instead of bought for.

killers.name: test_nearly_all_of_what_the_car_got_was_paid_for_by_the_roof
killers.title: Over a whole ordinary day, at least nineteen twentieths of the car's energy came from the roof.

killers.name: test_a_long_shadow_ends_the_session_rather_than_buying_through_it
killers.title: A cloud that stays stops the session instead of holding the floor on bought electricity.

killers.name: test_riding_out_a_shadow_stops_when_it_has_cost_enough
killers.title: Holding the floor through a shadow ends on the money it has spent, not only on the clock.

killers.name: test_riding_out_costs_three_times_as_much_on_three_phases_and_ends_three_times_sooner
killers.title: The same six amps is 4.1 kW on three phases, so the shadow is ridden out for a third as long.

killers.name: test_an_offer_of_nothing_is_a_pause_and_not_a_tiny_charge
killers.title: An offer of zero stops the car rather than being passed on as some very small current.

killers.name: test_the_floor_is_the_floor_whichever_wallbox_it_is
killers.title: No wallbox turns an offer below the pilot's floor into a charge: it refuses it or ignores it.

killers.name: test_a_meter_that_has_stopped_reporting_stops_the_charging
killers.title: When the meter reading goes stale the session stops rather than carry on in the dark.

killers.name: test_charging_starts_again_when_the_meter_comes_back
killers.title: Once the meter is reporting again the controller picks the session back up by itself.

killers.name: test_an_unplugged_car_is_offered_nothing
killers.title: With no car on the cable the controller offers nothing, whatever the sun is doing.

killers.name: test_the_session_is_not_started_again_the_moment_the_sun_peeps_out
killers.title: After a stop, a brief return of the sun is not enough: the sun has to stay before charging resumes.

killers.name: test_the_session_does_start_again_when_the_sun_really_is_back
killers.title: Once the sun has held above the floor for the resume delay, charging starts again by itself.

killers.name: test_a_load_that_outlasts_the_sun_does_not_leave_the_car_buying
killers.title: An oven on for forty minutes takes the car's power, not the grid's.

killers.name: test_a_load_bigger_than_the_sun_stops_the_car_rather_than_charging_on_the_grid
killers.title: A load that swallows the whole surplus stops the session instead of charging from the grid.
